import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/cameras.csv')

# Create a figure with subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 12))
fig.suptitle('Digital Camera Market Analysis: Technology Trends and Pricing', 
             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

# 1. Price vs Megapixels by Sensor Type (Top Left)
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
sensor_types = df['sensor_type'].unique()
colors = sns.color_palette('husl', n_colors=len(sensor_types))
for i, sensor in enumerate(sensor_types):
    data = df[df['sensor_type'] == sensor]
    ax1.scatter(data['megapixels'], data['price_usd'], 
               alpha=0.6, s=50, label=sensor, color=colors[i])
ax1.set_xlabel('Megapixels', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Camera Price vs Megapixels by Sensor Type', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend(title='Sensor Type', fontsize=9)
ax1.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 2. Average Price by Brand (Top Right)
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
brand_price = df.groupby('brand')['price_usd'].agg(['mean', 'count']).sort_values('mean', ascending=False)
top_brands = brand_price.head(10)
bars = ax2.barh(range(len(top_brands)), top_brands['mean'], color=sns.color_palette('viridis', len(top_brands)))
ax2.set_yticks(range(len(top_brands)))
ax2.set_yticklabels(top_brands.index, fontsize=10)
ax2.set_xlabel('Average Price (USD)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Top 10 Brands by Average Price', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)
for i, (idx, row) in enumerate(top_brands.iterrows()):
    ax2.text(row['mean'] + 50, i, f"${row['mean']:.0f}\n(n={row['count']})", 
            va='center', fontsize=8)

# 3. Technology Adoption Over Time (Bottom Left)
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
yearly_data = df.groupby('model_year').agg({
    'has_video_4k': 'mean',
    'megapixels': 'mean',
    'price_usd': 'mean'
}).reset_index()
yearly_data = yearly_data.sort_values('model_year')

ax3_twin = ax3.twinx()
line1 = ax3.plot(yearly_data['model_year'], yearly_data['has_video_4k'] * 100, 
                 marker='o', linewidth=2.5, color='#e74c3c', label='4K Video Adoption (%)')
line2 = ax3_twin.plot(yearly_data['model_year'], yearly_data['megapixels'], 
                      marker='s', linewidth=2.5, color='#3498db', label='Avg Megapixels')

ax3.set_xlabel('Model Year', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_ylabel('4K Video Adoption (%)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', color='#e74c3c')
ax3_twin.set_ylabel('Average Megapixels', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', color='#3498db')
ax3.set_title('Technology Evolution: 4K Video & Megapixels Over Time', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.tick_params(axis='y', labelcolor='#e74c3c')
ax3_twin.tick_params(axis='y', labelcolor='#3498db')
ax3.grid(alpha=0.3)

lines = line1 + line2
labels = [l.get_label() for l in lines]
ax3.legend(lines, labels, loc='upper left', fontsize=9)

# 4. Body Type and Weight Distribution (Bottom Right)
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
body_weight = df.groupby('body_type')['weight_grams'].apply(list).to_dict()
body_types_sorted = df.groupby('body_type')['weight_grams'].median().sort_values(ascending=False).index.tolist()
data_to_plot = [body_weight[bt] for bt in body_types_sorted]

bp = ax4.boxplot(data_to_plot, labels=body_types_sorted, patch_artist=True,
                 medianprops=dict(color='red', linewidth=2),
                 boxprops=dict(facecolor='lightblue', alpha=0.7))
ax4.set_xlabel('Body Type', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_ylabel('Weight (grams)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_title('Camera Weight Distribution by Body Type', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)
plt.setp(ax4.xaxis.get_majorticklabels(), rotation=45, ha='right')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
